findings.title: Trace ID is no longer logged on plugin request completion
findings.body: The removed code explicitly appended `traceID` from `tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false)` to the completion log line. The new code only calls `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)`, so the trace ID now appears only if the infra contextual logger happens to carry it. Nothing in this PR adds the trace ID to the contextual logger (`ContextualLoggerMiddleware.instrumentContext` does not include it). Trace correlation for 'Plugin Request Completed' logs is therefore silently lost.

findings.title: Nil request is dereferenced without a guard
findings.body: QueryData, CallResource, CheckHealth and CollectMetrics read `req.PluginContext` unconditionally, while the sibling LoggerMiddleware explicitly handles `req == nil`. A nil request will panic here before reaching the downstream client, which previously did not happen on this path for the logger. The nil handling should match LoggerMiddleware, or the behavior should be justified.

findings.title: New ContextualLoggerMiddleware has no tests
findings.body: The logging context enrichment (endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, uname) was moved out of the metrics middleware into this new file, but no test covers it. The existing metrics test was only renamed and no longer exercises context propagation. A regression in the attributes or in the ordering dependency with LoggerMiddleware would go unnoticed.

findings.title: Adding FromContext to the Logger interface breaks any other implementers
findings.body: `FromContext` is added to the exported `plog.Logger` interface. Any other implementation of this interface elsewhere in the repo or in plugins/extensions that is not updated will fail to compile. The PR only updates `TestLogger` and `grafanaInfraLogWrapper`, so the blast radius should be confirmed across the codebase.
